title: Cardiac Emergency — हृदय आघात
warning: Call 108 immediately. Every minute without CPR reduces survival by 10%.

steps.instruction: Check if person is responding: Tap shoulders, shout 'Are you okay?'
Call 108 immediately or ask someone nearby to call while you help.
steps.hint: Do not delay calling — do it first

steps.instruction: Check for breathing: Look for chest rise for no more than 10 seconds.
steps.hint: Occasional gasping is NOT normal breathing — start CPR

steps.instruction: Begin chest compressions: Heel of hand on centre of chest. Push hard and fast — at least 5 cm deep, 100-120 times per minute.
steps.hint: Push to the beat of 'Stayin' Alive' song — approximately 2 per second

steps.instruction: After every 30 compressions, give 2 rescue breaths if trained. If untrained, continue compressions only.
steps.hint: Hands-only CPR is still very effective

steps.instruction: Continue CPR without stopping until: ambulance arrives, person starts breathing, or you are exhausted.
If AED available: use it as soon as possible. Follow its voice instructions.
steps.hint: AEDs are available at some hospitals and public places
